title: Elon Dumped Bitcoin After 49 Days
facts:
Feb 2021: Tesla reveals it bought $1.5B of bitcoin. Mar 24: "You can now buy a Tesla with Bitcoin", and bitcoin paid to Tesla "will be retained as Bitcoin". May 12: payments suspended, BTC drops ~$3,000 in 15 minutes, and Elon says Tesla will not be selling any bitcoin. 2022: Tesla converts ~75% of its bitcoin to cash (+$936M).
Real BTC/USD daily chart (Bitstamp), Jan–May 2021. Tweets/statements shown are recreations.

title: Walmart Never Partnered With Litecoin. The Chart Didn't Know
facts: Sept 13, 2021: a fake press release on GlobeNewswire claimed Walmart would accept Litecoin from October 1, complete with made-up quotes from Walmart's CEO. Litecoin's official account shared it, and LTC ripped from ~$175 to ~$233 in minutes (Binance wick: $240). Then Walmart said it has no relationship with Litecoin, and the pump was gone. Litecoin's creator Charlie Lee: "this time we really messed up." Two months later, the same trick hit Kroger with Bitcoin Cash. Real LTC/USDT daily chart (Binance), Aug–Oct 2021. Posts shown are recreations.

title: This Bot Bought $8M of Ethereum… for $0
facts: Black Thursday, March 12 2020: ETH crashed ~43% in a day. Ethereum was so congested that MakerDAO's liquidation auctions got almost no bids, and one bidder won ~1,461 auctions with bids of zero DAI. ~$8.32M of collateral went for nothing; Maker minted new MKR to cover the hole; borrowers filed a $28.3M class action. Real ETH/USD daily chart (Bitstamp).

title: Ethereum Rewound Time to Undo a $50M Hack
facts: June 2016: The DAO, a code-run investment fund holding ~14% of all ether, was drained of 3.6M ETH through a refund bug. ETH fell from ~$21 to ~$13. On July 20 Ethereum hard-forked (block 1,920,000) to move the funds back, and the chain that refused became Ethereum Classic. Real ETH/USD daily chart (Kraken), May–Aug 2016. The on-screen code is a simplified illustration of the bug.

title: $3.36 Billion of Bitcoin… Hidden in a Popcorn Tin
facts: In 2012 James Zhong found a withdrawal glitch on Silk Road, the dark-web market: deposit bitcoin, hit withdraw over and over in rapid succession, and the site paid out several times. He ended up with about 50,000 BTC. Nine years later, on Nov 9, 2021, agents raided his Georgia home: devices in a safe under the floor, and a tiny single-board computer in a Cheetos popcorn tin in a bathroom closet. The bitcoin was worth over $3.36 billion. The next day BTC hit its then all-time high of $69,000. He pleaded guilty to wire fraud and got one year and a day. Real BTC/USD daily chart (Bitstamp), Oct–Nov 2021.

title: He Paid for a Hit… The Hitman Was a Cop
facts: 2013: Silk Road's boss, Ross Ulbricht ('Dread Pirate Roberts'), believed a worker, Curtis Green, had stolen his bitcoin. Prosecutors say he paid a 'hitman' called Nob $80,000. Nob sent proof photos. Plot twist: Nob was DEA agent Carl Force, the photos were staged, and Green was alive and in on it. The missing bitcoin had been taken by Secret Service agent Shaun Bridges. Both agents went to prison (78 and 71 months). Oct 2, 2013: the FBI shut Silk Road down and BTC fell from ~$127 to $85 that day (Bitstamp). Ulbricht got life in 2015 and a presidential pardon in January 2025. The murder-for-hire allegation was never tried in court. Real BTC/USD daily chart (Bitstamp), Sep–Oct 2013. No real photos shown.

title: The Cryptoqueen Took $4 Billion… and Vanished
facts: Ruja Ignatova sold OneCoin, a 'Bitcoin killer' with no real blockchain, and raised over $4 billion. On Oct 25, 2017 she boarded a flight from Sofia to Athens and was never seen again. That day BTC closed at $5,736 on Bitstamp; on Dec 17 it hit $19,666, about 3.4x. She is on the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, and the US reward is $5 million (June 2024). Bulgarian police papers reported in 2023 claim she was killed in 2018; prosecutors do not treat them as evidence and no body has been found. Real BTC/USD daily chart (Bitstamp), Oct–Dec 2017.

title: 11,196 Years in Prison for One Crypto Exchange
facts: Spring 2021, Turkey: the exchange Thodex ran a promo giving new users free Dogecoin. DOGE rocketed to $0.45 (Apr 16, Binance). Days after the promo ended, Thodex locked DOGE withdrawals 'for maintenance', and on April 21 the site said 'temporarily closed'. Users were locked out; loss estimates range widely (from tens of millions to $2B+). CEO Faruk Fatih Özer had already left for Albania. He was arrested there in Aug 2022 and in Sept 2023 a Turkish court sentenced him to 11,196 years. On Nov 1, 2025 he was found dead in his prison cell; authorities opened an investigation. Real DOGE/USDT daily chart (Binance), Mar–Apr 2021.

title: Held in a Luxury Townhouse… for a Bitcoin Password
facts: May 6, 2025: a 28-year-old Italian crypto trader arrived at an eight-bedroom townhouse in SoHo, New York. Prosecutors say he was held there for more than two weeks and threatened to make him give up his bitcoin password. On May 22 bitcoin hit a record $112,000. The next day he said the password was on his computer; when a captor went to get it, he ran out and flagged down a traffic officer. Two crypto investors, John Woeltz and William Duplessie, were charged and pleaded not guilty. They are presumed innocent unless proven guilty. Real BTC/USD daily chart (Bitstamp), May 2025.

title: He Scammed Investors… Then Met New "Investors" in Dubai
facts: Roman Novak served prison time in Russia for fraud, moved to the UAE, built crypto apps and claimed to know Telegram's founder. In early October 2025 he and his wife drove out to meet would-be investors near Hatta and never came back. Four days later BTC hit a record $126,272 (Oct 6), then crashed to $109,683 on Oct 10. Russia's Investigative Committee opened a murder case; reports say the kidnappers were after his crypto. Three suspects are in pretrial detention in Russia. Many graphic details in the press come from unverified tabloid reports and are left out. Real BTC/USD daily chart (Bitstamp), Sep–Oct 2025.

title: "Steady Lads"… Now It's 15 Years in Prison
facts: Sequel to our Short #7. May 2022: LUNA crashed from $80+ to almost zero and about $40 billion was wiped out; Do Kwon tweeted 'steady lads'. In Sept 2022 South Korea issued an arrest warrant. In March 2023 he was arrested at Podgorica airport in Montenegro with forged passports and held there until his extradition to New York on Dec 31, 2024. In August 2025 he pleaded guilty to fraud. Prosecutors asked for 12 years; on Dec 11, 2025 Judge Paul Engelmayer said 'you chose to lie' and gave him 15. Real LUNA/USDT 4h chart (Binance), May 2022. Tweet shown is a recreation.

title: POV: You Put $1,000 Into LUNA
facts:
POV: it's May 7, 2022. You put $1,000 into LUNA at the daily close: $68.13 a coin. Easy money.
Day 1: the UST stablecoin slips to about $0.98. Just a wobble. You hold.
Day 2: Do Kwon tweets "Deploying more capital - steady lads." You hold. By midnight UTC your $1,000 is $444.59.
Day 3: down 74% ($256.27). Day 4: $15.81. Day 5: the Terra chain is halted and Binance suspends LUNA trading.
Last candle in the data (May 13, 00:00-04:00 UTC, close $0.00005): your $1,000 is $0.00073 - less than a tenth of a cent.

title: Same $1,000. One Held, One Panicked
facts:
Two investors (hypothetical). Same day, same $1,000.
Feb 13, 2020: Sam and Ahmad both buy bitcoin at the daily close, $10,228.67.
Mar 12, 2020 (Black Thursday): bitcoin closes at $4,841.67, down 39.1% from the day's open. Sam panic-sells: $473.34 left.
Ahmad does nothing. At the latest daily close (Oct 13, 2026: $83,093.57) his $1,000 is worth $8,123.59.

title: He Called Bitcoin "Rat Poison Squared"… Here's the Chart
facts:
May 5, 2018: at the Berkshire Hathaway meeting, Warren Buffett told CNBC bitcoin is "probably rat poison squared." Bitcoin closed that day at $9,823.28.
April 30, 2022: he went further - "If you told me you own all of the bitcoin in the world and you offered it to me for $25, I wouldn't take it." Close that day: $37,639.80.
Latest daily close (Oct 13, 2026): $83,093.57 - 8.46x the 2018 price.
(Buffett's point was that bitcoin produces nothing; this is about the price, not about who is right.)
Real BTC/USD (Bitstamp) data: daily closes via TradingView. Quote cards are text only.
